approach: Use main(api) with six helpers: observe, fit_scene, candidates, move_lease, verify_effect, and persist. Phases are runtime identification, pregrasp measurement, open approach, closure, retention-test lift, transfer, placement, release, withdrawal, and final assessment. Recognize the cream-cheese package and bowl afresh; supplied images guide semantics, never stored coordinates. Establish a textured package reference before closure when possible. Use short api.drive leases, at most 12 calls each, and individual api.control calls around contact or changing evidence. Transfer above locally measured obstacles, then either lower the package inside or release immediately above the opening while keeping fingers outside the rim. Return completion_proposed and JSON evidence of actual containment and release, not merely successful pose control.
observations: Query api.state and current camera calibration. Schema-declared api.review requests identify package top/side landmarks, table samples, inner-rim samples, bowl interior, and a textured package polygon; use semantic physical identities, explicit camera/box/stride, and supported named points/regions within review limits. Separate obstruction, incomplete visibility, and unknown identity. Inspect measurement_errors and dictionary membership. Use api.point/cloud for metric surfaces and validated plane_point intersections for visible boundaries with mixed depth. Initialize track_init; validate track_update identity, inliers, spread relative to residuals, and uncertainty_floor_m. Store frame_id and reference_frame_id correctly. Unknown tracking is not object displacement. Hand interaction invalidates package stationarity; transport requires current envelope evidence, whereas differential retention needs only a current identified patch. Static bowl/table priors remain conditional on current partial evidence and absence of intervening interaction.
geometry: Model the package as a validated local cuboid and the bowl mouth as an approximately horizontal inner circle. Use geo.plane coefficients, geo.circle_xy diagnostics, geo.rotation/transform, pad_position, and attachment_error; reject inadequate models rather than invent hidden corners. Infer package thickness from visible sides and support. Derive open aperture and finger envelope from proprioception/own_geometry. Search two grasp-axis choices and low/middle/high points of feasible contact-height intervals. For contact intervals [a+t,b+t] and [c,d], positive overlap m requires c+m-b <= t <= d-m-a and m <= min(b-a,d-c); intersect with table clearance. Choose m and control tolerances jointly from dimensions and uncertainty. Search finger-inside descent versus above-rim release. Compute nominal opening slack from transformed package vertices and measured inner radius, including release height and finger clearance. Separately propagate shared plane, correspondence, fit and control uncertainties without repeated charging; heuristic bounds are not calibrated confidence. Failed conservative slack triggers measurement/configuration search, not impossibility. Actual retention, clearance effects and seating require post-action evidence.
gate_dependencies: Identification needs current matching appearance and sufficient local metric geometry. Approach needs an attainable local alignment and no observed obstruction; it does not require certification of the entire later route. Closure needs feasible aperture, side overlap and support clearance. A small upward retention test needs a measured local test corridor and an identified reference, not prior proof of attachment or a complete visible perimeter. Retention compares independently observed patch motion with measured hand motion. Transfer additionally needs a justified patch-to-envelope relation. Placement needs current opening-relative geometry for the chosen descent/release mode. Opening needs placement evidence; withdrawal then produces independent release evidence. Completion requires package containment, interior seating rather than rim bridging, and stable separation from the open withdrawn fingers.
bounded_recovery: Give every gate pass, observed-failure and inconclusive branches. Allow two genuinely different observation moves per phase, one replacement patch, two grasp trials and two placement configurations, all within global caps of 24 reviews and 180 control/choose calls and actual host budgets. Reserve 40 calls and four reviews for terminal actions/recovery. Recompute remaining waypoint counts from distance and the smallest planned progress leg whenever shortening motion; visibility moves do not count as progress. Unknown tracking triggers alternate-view/current-landmark evidence, not repeated hidden-mark requests. Failed retention permits measured set-down/open/regrasp; uncertain holding permits set-down only with justified local envelope/support evidence. After release, missing evidence permits observation, not automatic regrasp. Refine sub-deadband corrections within API tolerance limits or use a justified bounded trial. Checkpoint intent and acknowledged jaw transitions before subsequent sensing, retaining physical continuity across repairs. Use six bounded 8-KiB records and a 12-entry diagnostic window; log failed slacks and uncertainties.
jev_contract: Provide program-derived phase, targets, geometry provenance, uncertainty, candidate feasibility, obstacle/visibility distinctions and remaining budgets. Jev receives structured features, not images, hidden state or executable Python. api.choose selects only among two to eight explicitly described supported candidates; skip it for a sole candidate. Each branch question names its subject and feature selectors. Every physical update uses real api.control/drive with exactly x,y,z,rx,ry,rz,gripper questions. Each axis names its world component: negative means decrease, hold means within tolerance, positive means increase; gripper choices refer explicitly to objective open/close/keep. Host residual magnitudes are bounded; Jev answers execute unchanged. Save choices, acknowledged_steps, frame_id and actual state; reached proves neither attachment nor placement. Contradictory choices or stalled leases trigger reassessment, not fabricated acknowledgment. Independent observations establish each object effect and final outcome.
